description: QUAL-08: read_jpeg (L55), read_webp, and read_ico use to_i32! (unsafe cast) for width/height. If decoded value exceeds Int32::MAX, this silently wraps producing garbage values. Use safe to_i32 instead. File: src/vug/image_dimensions.cr
title: QUAL: Replace unsafe to_i32! with safe to_i32 in ImageDimensions
